name: Hyoka – Customer Reviews, Product Reviews, Photo & Video UGC & Loyalty for WooCommerce
author: YS Innovations

sections.description:
Hyoka turns every completed order into an opportunity for social proof. Shoppers trust other shoppers more than they trust a product description. Star ratings, real photos, honest reviews, and answered questions are what make a shopper feel safe enough to buy.

Hyoka is a WooCommerce reviews plugin for collecting customer reviews, photo reviews, video reviews, and product Q&A, and for rewarding loyal customers — all from your own WordPress dashboard.

Hyoka collects all of this for you automatically. It sends review request emails after an order is delivered. It lets customers upload photo and video reviews. It shows everything on your store with simple review widgets.

Hyoka also uses AI to save you time. It reads each review and marks its sentiment as positive, neutral, or negative. It writes a reply for you in one click. It blocks spam reviews before they reach your site. You do not need any technical skill to use these AI tools — everything works from simple buttons in your WordPress dashboard.

Customers can also ask questions on your product pages. Hyoka’s Q&A tool helps you answer before a shopper leaves your store without buying. Every time a customer leaves a review, Hyoka can reward them with a coupon — with bonus rewards for reviews that include photo or video. Your happy customers can also share a referral link to bring in new buyers.

As a WordPress review plugin, Hyoka is not an outside SaaS service. There is no monthly fee, no limit on reviews, and your review data always stays on your own server. Hyoka also adds review star ratings to your Google search results through Product and AggregateRating schema, and automatically tells search engines about your review pages through an XML sitemap, so more shoppers can find your store on Google.

In short, with one plugin you get: more product reviews, real photo and video reviews from customers, AI review tools, product Q&A, loyalty coupons and referrals, Mailchimp lead sync, and better visibility in Google search — all without hiring extra staff or paying for a separate SaaS review tool.

Visit the Hyoka website for a full product overview, browse the complete feature list, or check pricing and plans if you’re ready to unlock Pro features.

What Hyoka Does For Your Store

Collects product reviews with star ratings — on the product page or through a simple review form.

Lets customers upload photo and video reviews — real unboxing pictures and video clips, straight from a phone.

Displays reviews using storefront widgets — review boxes, video grids, sliders, and testimonial displays that match your theme.

Sends automated review request emails — after an order is marked complete, or manually whenever you choose.

Uses built-in AI to save you time — sentiment detection, auto-generated reply drafts, review summaries, and spam filtering.

Rewards customers with coupons and referrals — automatic discount codes for reviewing, plus shareable referral links, with bonus rewards for photo and video reviews.

Syncs leads with Mailchimp — automatically capture and manage customer leads directly through Mailchimp integration.

Runs a dedicated Q&A section on product pages — shoppers ask, you (or your community) answer.

Imports and exports reviews in one click — move data in from CSV, Judge.me, or Yotpo without losing history.

Adds Google Rich Snippets and review sitemaps — Product and AggregateRating schema markup, plus XML sitemap support for every review page.

How Automated Review Request Emails Work

You don’t need to manually ask every customer for a review. As a review request email plugin for WooCommerce, Hyoka does it for you in four steps:

A customer places an order in your WooCommerce store.

You mark the order as complete once it ships.

After the number of days you set, Hyoka automatically emails the customer asking for a review.

The customer rates the product, writes feedback, and uploads photos or video — all in one simple form.

Store managers also get:

One review form covering every item from a single order.

Manual review invite emails for specific orders.

Emails automatically personalized with the customer’s name and order details.

An email design editor to match your store’s colors and branding, with fully optimized templates.

Test sends, so you can preview exactly what customers receive.

Open and click tracking on every review request email.

A follow-up email asking specifically for photos or video after a review is submitted.

A second reminder email for customers who missed the first one.

Automatic thank-you emails when a review comes in, and reply notifications.

Why Product Reviews Increase WooCommerce Sales

A shopper who sees real reviews, ratings, and customer photos is far more likely to buy than one who sees a product page with none. Reviews answer the questions a product description can’t: does this actually work, is this store trustworthy, did anyone else have a good experience.

Hyoka builds that trust with:

Photo reviews — real product photos from customers, not stock images.

Video reviews — short customer video clips showing the product in use.

Bonus rewards for photo and video reviews — extra coupon incentives that motivate customers to submit richer, more persuasive UGC.

AI sentiment analysis — automatically tags each review as positive, neutral, or negative.

AI smart replies — get an AI-generated review reply draft for any customer review in seconds.

AI review summaries — long reviews condensed into a few clear points.

Trust badges — a snapshot of your store’s review reputation, shown anywhere on your site.

Site-wide rating widget — your overall store rating, displayed wherever you need it.

Review filtering and sorting — by star rating, date, or most helpful.

Reader voting and reply threads — shoppers can vote on helpful reviews and discuss them.

Verified purchase badges — shows which reviewers actually bought the product.

Lightweight, conditional script loading — review widgets don’t slow down your store.

How Hyoka Helps With WooCommerce SEO

Every new review, photo, and video is fresh content on your product page — and fresh, unique content is exactly what search engines reward. Hyoka goes further than most WooCommerce review plugins by turning that content into structured data search engines can actually read.

Hyoka now includes:

Google Rich Snippets (JSON-LD) with Product and AggregateRating schema, so your star ratings can appear directly in Google search results.

Review Rich Results markup that improves the visibility of star ratings and review counts in search listings.

A dedicated All Reviews page with pagination and SEO-friendly review URLs, supported by an improved pagination UI, giving search engines a clean, crawlable page of customer feedback for every product.

Review Sitemap support — Yoast SEO, Rank Math, and All in One SEO compatible, so review pages are included in your XML sitemap and get discovered and indexed faster.

Unique, keyword-rich content written in your customers’ own words.

Real user-generated photos and video that a static product page can’t produce alone.

Enhanced search snippets, giving shoppers more reason to click your listing over a competitor’s.

In short: Hyoka is a WooCommerce review schema and rich snippet plugin that helps product pages rank better in Google search, appear in star-rating rich results, and get pulled into AI-powered search summaries that rely on structured review data.

Customer Q&A: Answer Questions Before They Cause Abandoned Carts

A shopper with an unanswered question rarely checks out — they leave the tab open and go compare, or they simply leave. A visible Q&A section on the product page closes that gap.

Included with Q&A:

A dedicated Q&A tab on every product page.

A popup Q&A widget, so questions and answers can also appear outside the main product tab.

Automatic email notifications when a question is answered.

Threaded replies, so buyers can respond to each other.

Spam protection and keyword filtering to keep questions on-topic.

A full activity log of every review, discussion, and Q&A update.

Loyalty Rewards and Referral Program

Getting a customer to buy again is far cheaper than finding a new one. Hyoka turns every review into a reason for a customer to come back:

Automatic coupon rewards when a customer submits a review.

Bonus rewards for photo and video reviews — an extra incentive layer that encourages the kind of visual UGC that converts best.

Fair reward rules — coupons are earned for leaving a review, not just a positive one, which keeps every review honest.

Discount codes emailed automatically right after a review is submitted.

A referral program so customers can share their own referral link with friends, now built around the same coupon-based rewards used for reviews.

Referral sharing through widgets and shortcodes, so a referral link can be placed anywhere on your site, not only in an email.

Coupon expiry reminder emails that create urgency to use the reward.

Import and Export Reviews

Switching from another review platform shouldn’t mean losing years of star ratings and customer photos. Hyoka lets you import reviews from Judge.me and import reviews from Yotpo in a few clicks, with no lost history.

Import and export product and store reviews.

Import and export reviews that include photo and video attachments.

One-click import support for Judge.me and Yotpo export files.

Import and export customer questions and answers.

Want the full breakdown before you install? See everything Hyoka does on the features page, or compare plans on the pricing page.

Blocks

This plugin provides 3 optimized blocks for easy visual placement:

Reviews Grid: A clean grid layout of product and store reviews.

Trust Badge: A summary badge of product and store reviews, placeable anywhere on your site.

Reviews Slider: A smooth, swipeable slider of top customer testimonials and media.
sections.installation:
Minimum System Requirements

WordPress 5.3 or higher

WooCommerce 4.0 or higher

PHP 7.4 or higher

Automatic Installation

Log in to your WordPress Dashboard.

Go to Plugins → Add New.

Search for “Hyoka”.

Click Install Now, then Activate.

Select Hyoka from your admin menu to configure your settings.

Manual Installation

Download the plugin ZIP file from your account.

Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.

Choose the downloaded ZIP file and click Install Now.

Activate the plugin and go to Hyoka in your admin menu.
sections.faq:
Is Hyoka a SaaS platform or a native WordPress plugin?

Hyoka is a fully native WordPress and WooCommerce plugin. Your review data stays on your own server — there’s no monthly subscription and no limit on how many reviews you can collect.

Can I migrate my existing reviews from Judge.me, Yotpo, or CSV?

Yes. Hyoka’s importer brings in past reviews from CSV spreadsheets, Judge.me, or Yotpo exports, keeping your star ratings, dates, and photos or video intact.

How do automated review request emails work?

Once an order is marked “Completed” in WooCommerce, Hyoka waits the number of days you’ve set, then emails the customer a direct link to a mobile-friendly review form. No manual follow-up needed.

Does the AI review assistant cost extra?

No. AI sentiment analysis, smart reply drafts, and spam filtering are all built into your WordPress dashboard at no separate cost. Some advanced AI and moderation tools are part of Pro — see pricing and plans for the full breakdown.

Will Hyoka slow down my WooCommerce store?

No. Review scripts load only on the pages where review widgets actually appear, so the rest of your store — including checkout — stays fast.

Do customers get a coupon even if they leave a negative review?

Yes. Coupon rewards are given for submitting a review, not for a specific star rating. Rewarding only positive reviews would make the whole review system less trustworthy — so Hyoka rewards honesty instead.

Do photo and video reviews earn extra rewards?

Yes. Hyoka supports bonus coupon rewards specifically for reviews that include photos or video, giving customers an added incentive to submit richer, more visual feedback.

Does Hyoka support Google Rich Snippets and review schema markup?

Yes. Hyoka automatically adds JSON-LD structured data using Product and AggregateRating schema, along with Review Rich Results markup, so your star ratings and review counts are eligible to appear directly in Google search results.

Does Hyoka support XML sitemaps for reviews?

Yes. Hyoka includes Review Sitemap support that’s compatible with Yoast SEO, Rank Math, and All in One SEO, so your review pages are included in your site’s XML sitemap for faster discovery and indexing.

Can I show a popup review widget instead of only a page section?

Yes. Hyoka includes popup review widgets, so reviews can be shown in a popup in addition to the standard storefront widgets.

Can customers refer friends without leaving a review?

Yes. The referral program uses its own shareable link, which customers can get through a widget or a shortcode, separate from the review flow.
